byte_domains: INSPECT TALLYING/REPLACING/CONVERTING target bytes + tally receiver bytes
damage_if_overclaimed: a wrong overlap/leading/region/case assumption in an INSPECT-based cleanup or validation transform silently mis-counts or mis-mutates a field
lie_prevented: 'INSPECT counts/replaces are obvious' -- ALL counts NON-OVERLAPPING left-to-right (AAAAAA FOR ALL AA = 3 not 5), LEADING stops at the first non-match, BEFORE/AFTER restrict the region (BEFORE an absent delimiter = the whole field), matching is exact bytes with no case folding
negative_claims: lie prevented: 'INSPECT counts/replaces are obvious' -- ALL counts NON-OVERLAPPING left-to-right (AAAAAA FOR ALL AA = 3 not 5), LEADING stops at the first non-match, BEFORE/AFTER restrict the region (BEFORE an absent delimiter = the whole field), matching is exact bytes with no case folding
positive_claims: the target bytes and tally receiver bytes of narrow INSPECT statements, matching cobc/libcob byte-for-byte: TALLYING FOR ALL (every NON-OVERLAPPING occurrence, left-to-right consume), LEADING (run from the region start), CHARACTERS (every position)
and BEFORE/AFTER INITIAL region restriction (BEFORE absent = whole region, AFTER absent = empty). Scanning is left-to-right non-overlapping
matching is exact bytes (no case folding)
